title: K Closest Points to Origin - Solution
intuition: Given an array of points where points[i] = [x, y] represents a point on the X-Y plane and an integer k, return the k closest points to the origin.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use a max-heap of size k storing pairs of (distance, point) to keep tracking k closest.
